# neo4j

Neo4j openCypher access through the official drivers (Python, Java, Go, JavaScript) - bounded, anchored, parameterized queries, and EXPLAIN/PROFILE plans imported as dumps (AllNodesScan, CartesianProduct, fan-out).

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-013` | medium | Graph traversal/query without a limit |
| `AF-GDB-004` | high | openCypher variable-length path without an upper bound |
| `AF-GDB-005` | medium | openCypher MATCH with no label or property anchor |
| `AF-GDB-006` | medium | openCypher disconnected patterns form a cartesian product |
| `AF-GDB-008` | medium | Graph query text built by concatenation or interpolation |
| `AF-GDB-024` | medium | Neo4j plan uses AllNodesScan or CartesianProduct |
| `AF-GDB-025` | low | Executed plan shows a high fan-out ratio |
